text:
ashok: alert from monitoring — streaming error rate jumped to 18% for /v1/streams (paging-enabled clients). Noticed at 09:20 UTC. Can someone pick this up? :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (streaming/paging errors). Severity: P1. Pager duty notified.
ashok: root logs show a lot of connection resets on edge-proxy with 431 responses and `connection reset by peer` in runtime. Paging cursors are often returned empty for multi-page responses.
julia: I'm oncall for infra. Pulling traces now. Early hypothesis: new SDK v6.0 changed the streaming chunk header and now some proxies reject header sizes > 8k. We're seeing `431 Request Header Fields Too Large` in the proxy logs correlated with client version header `X-Client-Streaming: v6.0` and `X-Paging-Token` being present.
maria: customer reports: "results truncated mid-page" and "cursor missing" from two enterprise customers (acme-corp, finlytics). One has open support ticket, they see ~12% of streaming requests failing.
julia: quick grep from edge-proxy:
```
2026-03-15T09:19:41Z proxy[edge-7]: "POST /v1/streams" 431 0ms "-" "x-client-streaming: v6.0, x-paging-token: eyJhbGci..."
2026-03-15T09:19:42Z proxy[edge-7]: connection reset by peer (client 10.4.5.7)
```
julia: paging tokens in v6 SDK are longer because we added an extra signature field (for forward-compat). That combined with some large metadata headers from customers pushes header length over the proxy limit.
ashok: confirmed: the runtime itself returns full payload if we bypass proxy. So root cause is header size rejection at layer7.
ops-ci: rolling metric: 18% ERROR for streaming endpoints for customers with paging enabled; global requests unchanged. Impact appears limited to streaming + paging + SDK v6.0.
maria:Impact summary for CS/exec:
- Affected surface: hosted streaming endpoints when clients include paging tokens + SDK v6.0 header.
- Affected customers: ~18 customers seen, 2 enterprise customers >10% error, 1 open escalated ticket.
- Latency: failed quickly (431) — no CPU/backend saturation.
ashok: mitigation options:
1) increase header size limit on edge-proxy (fast but requires config rollout across regions)
2) feature-flag kill for server-side header checking for SDK v6 (if we have such a flag)
3) rollback the SDK v6 feature flag/rollout (client-side change; slower since clients already rolled)
4) temporary canary rollback at deploy level — if release was via feature flags we can flip it off now.
julia: I can flip edge-proxy header limit to 16k as a quick fix. It requires a rolling config update on the load-balancers (estimated 6–8 minutes per region). Will do if ops is ok.
ashok: do it. In parallel I'll check if the release has a server-side FF we can kill. releasebot: Release v6-streaming rolled out via ff: `sdk_v6_streaming` set to 20% across hosted.
maria: flip the kill-switch for that flag now if possible — that should remove the `X-Client-Streaming` server-side behavior that triggers longer tokens.
releasebot: Received command to change flag: awaiting confirmation. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
ashok: command to ops: `curl -X POST https://internal-console/api/flags/sdk_v6_streaming -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"state":"off"}'`
julia: I'll start the proxy config increase now in us-east-1, then eu-west-1. Executing: `k8s rollout restart ds/edge-proxy --namespace=edge --selector=region=us-east-1` — ETA 6m.
ops-ci: us-east-1 proxy change done, errors dropped to 3% in 90s. eu-west change in progress.
maria: CS update draft for customers:
"We identified an interoperability issue between the newly released SDK v6 streaming header and our edge proxy header size limit which caused streaming requests with paging to be rejected. We have applied mitigations and customers should see normal behavior now. We will follow up with a permanent fix and timeline."
lee: I'm taking handoff at 09:35 UTC. Summary: transient P1, mitigation applied (edge header limit raised + `sdk_v6_streaming` flag turned off in hosted rollout). Need follow-up items: revert proxy limit change with a proper config that accounts for header size, and a runtime fallback to accept truncated paging token formats for compatibility.
ashok: handoff checklist for night oncall @lee:
- Confirm eu-west finished (if not, finish it). -> eu-west finished at 09:31 UTC, errors ~2.2% then 0.8% after flag flip.
- Confirm feature flag state — currently OFF (releasebot confirmed).
- Open a post-incident task: `ENG-3245` "Ensure proxy header size and SDK paging token size are compatible / add graceful rejection reason".
maria: customer comms: sent initial messages to 3 customers, CS will send private APAC note as we finish analysis.
julia: short-term followups: add proxy metric alert for 431 rate, add unit test in edge-proxy to reject or log long headers with reason code.
lee: I'll own the incident until we have ENG-3245 and a fix branch created. Taking ownership. Handoff done. :handshake:
incident-bot: INC-2026-042 marked as Mitigated by julia at 09:34 UTC.
ashok: final notes: root cause = header length blowup due to SDK v6 token change + some customer metadata. Mitigations = edge header limit increase + ff kill-turnoff. Next steps = proper compatibility fix, ship small runtime patch to accept v6 tokens truncated form, and coordinate with SDK team to shorten tokens or make header usage optional.
maria: triage severity to Sev-3 post-mitigation; customer impact documented. Closing thread for now but will update with ENG-3245 progress.
lee: acknowledged.
